measurement: Cross-venue coefficient of variation of combined bid-plus-ask USD notional depth within 3 basis points of each venue mid price for BTCUSDT linear perpetuals, sampled every 30 minutes after synchronized official-API snapshots are available; require at least four eligible venues.
formula: For each venue v, mid_v=(best_bid_v+best_ask_v)/2 and D_v=sum(price*quantity for bids with price>=mid_v*(1-0.0003))+sum(price*quantity for asks with price<=mid_v*(1+0.0003)); value=sample_stdev(D_v)/mean(D_v) across eligible venues whose snapshot timestamps are within 60 seconds of the observation timestamp.
data_source: Official public Level-2 order-book APIs for Binance, OKX, Bybit, Bitget, MEXC, and Hyperliquid; preserve raw responses, exchange event timestamps when supplied, collector receipt timestamps, sequence identifiers, and SHA-256 hashes.
